universe: all binary BTC above thresholds in that day's single official daily event; no post-result selection
feature_role: predictor only; not Binance settlement reference
basis_assumption: unverified Coinbase USD vs Binance USDT basis; prediction validity judged against official labels, not called fair value
nominal_target_note: forecast approximation only; each contract's exact candle rules retained; nonmatching or ambiguous rules abstain
clock_assumption: both consistent unauthenticated NTP samples; conditional research timing, no admission to old protocol
fee_source: CLOB fd matched to Gamma feeSchedule and token ids, exponent 1, taker only
fee_formula: shares * rate * p * (1-p); round upward to 5 decimal places
selection: maximum conservative net edge across YES/NO and thresholds; ties by lexicographic condition id then YES
unknown_other_costs_action: financial ABSTAIN; payoff and net return null; no financial GO
cost_evidence_requirement: documented all-in upper bound applicable to the hypothetical path; sponsorship eligibility cannot be presumed
resolution_labels: official final resolved state only; closed or outcomePrices 0/1 insufficient
benchmark: same-time YES midpoint; day-mean Brier improvement, thresholds clustered by settlement day
missing_predictions: retain full predeclared cohort with null score; never invent p or carry forward
reports: full and descriptive clean cohorts; excluded point fraction; continuous excluded-time fraction null unless measured
evaluation: once after the full 90-day cohort; no interim performance tuning
bootstrap: circular moving blocks of seven consecutive settlement days, preserve missing days and within-day dependence
go: longer PAPER measurement only: all counts/coverage gates AND verified cost evidence AND Brier improvement lower bound >0 AND hypothetical net payoff lower bound >0
